snippet.title: Ova Magica ► Console Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Escape everyday stress and start a new life in Clover Town! With adorable blob creatures by your side, you’ll farm, make new friends, and explore uncharted lands. Will you find love, or become the greatest blob trainer? Your story is yours to shape in Ova Magica!

Ova Magica blends farm-life simulation with creature-collecting JRPG gameplay for a cozy yet adventurous experience.

Already out on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299170/Ova_Magica/
